articles.headline: Americast discusses a Michigan Democrat endorsing a Republican senate candidate
articles.title: Americast
articles.summary: Hosts Justin Webb and Anthony Zurcher discuss a Michigan Democrat unexpectedly endorsing a Republican candidate in a crucial United States Senate contest. Broadcasting from Washington, District of Columbia, the podcast analyses the defection's impact on Democrats, the 2028 presidential election, and Donald Trump's final campaign speeches in Kansas and Iowa ahead of the midterm elections.
articles.description: Will this stop the Democrats taking back the Senate?

articles.headline: Madhya Pradesh Police inspector mowed down by truck carrying illicit liquor in Dewas
articles.title: Madhya Pradesh Police inspector mowed down by truck carrying illicit liquor in Dewas
articles.summary: A Madhya Pradesh Police inspector was killed in Dewas district after being struck by a truck intercepted for allegedly smuggling illegal liquor. According to the superintendent of police, the officer was leading a team on the Indore-Betul highway when the incident occurred. Police seized the vehicle containing over 1,800 litres of liquor without bills as an investigation and search for the fleeing staff continue.
articles.description: Another police officer said that the truck driver and staff fled the scene after leaving the truck at some distance following the incident, and a search is underway for them

articles.headline: Researchers in Keralam study potential links between gut bacteria and Parkinson's disease
articles.title: Study in Keralam sheds light on link between gut bacteria, Parkinson’s disease
articles.summary: Scientists at Cochin University of Science and Technology and the Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology published findings revealing distinct gut bacteria differences in Parkinson's disease patients. Funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research, the study analyzed stool samples from 65 patients and 65 healthy individuals using metagenomic sequencing to explore early diagnostic tests and treatments.
articles.description: Researchers from CUSAT and SCTIMST, Thiruvananthapuram, find significant differences between gut bacteria of Parkinson’s patients and those of healthy individuals

articles.headline: Jio Platforms shares rise over 3% following September quarter results
articles.title: Jio Platforms’ shares climb over 3% post Q2 earnings
articles.summary: Shares of Jio Platforms increased by more than 3% on November 2, 2026, after reporting a 13.7% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹8,389 crore for the September quarter. According to a regulatory filing, revenue from operations grew 11.4% to ₹40,475 crore. This marked the digital and telecom company's first earnings report since its stock market debut last week.
articles.description: Jio Platforms on October 30 reported a 13.7% rise in consolidated net profit to ₹8,389 crore for the September 2026 quarter

articles.headline: Three Aam Aadmi Party MLAs join Bharatiya Janata Party in Punjab
articles.title: Three AAP MLAs join BJP in Punjab
articles.summary: Three Aam Aadmi Party legislators, including Kunwar Vijay Pratap Singh, Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra and Chetan Singh Jauramajra, joined the Bharatiya Janata Party at headquarters in New Delhi on November 2, 2026. Two of the quitting politicians cited unfulfilled promises from the 2022 polls. The ruling Aam Aadmi Party criticised the Bharatiya Janata Party for inducting leaders facing serious allegations.
articles.description: On November 1, 2026, the AAP legislators, one of whom a former Minister, resigned from the party’s primary membership

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate registers money laundering case against Subhash Chandra
articles.title: ED registers money laundering case against Subhash Chandra
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate registered a money laundering case against media baron Subhash Chandra on November 2, 2026. Officials stated the action follows a Central Bureau of Investigation first information report regarding an alleged loan fraud that caused a ₹1,322 crore loss to Life Insurance Corporation Housing Finance Limited. Mr. Chandra allegedly inflated his net worth to secure loans before defaulting.
articles.description: The officials said the case has been filed under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), taking cognisance of a CBI FIR

articles.headline: Odisha chief minister announces special relief package after cyclone
articles.title: Odisha CM announces special package for families affected by Cyclone Arnab
articles.summary: Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced a special relief package on November 2, 2026, providing 50 kilograms of rice and 2,500 rupees to every family impacted by flooding and Cyclone Arnab in southern districts including Ganjam, Gajapati and Kandhamal. The administration will also distribute agricultural input subsidies ranging from 8,500 to 17,000 rupees per hectare to small and marginal farmers who suffered crop losses exceeding 33%.
articles.description: After reviewing the prevailing flood situation in the State in the evening, CM Majhi said people in several districts, especially Ganjam, Gajapati and Kandhamal, were affected by cyclone Arnab and its aftermath of heavy rainfall

articles.headline: French police deploy tear gas as hundreds of thousands protest
articles.title: Tension and clashes as hundreds of thousands protest again in France
articles.summary: Security forces clashed with demonstrators in Paris and Lyon during the third consecutive weekend of nationwide rallies concerning the cost of living and school conditions. Organisers estimated nearly half a million participants, while the French Ministry of Interior reported 320,000 attendees and at least 290 arrests. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu held meetings with student unions as similar youth-led protests also emerged in Germany, Spain, and Italy.
articles.description: Authorities say 320,000 march on third consecutive weekend of demonstrations over cost of living and state of schools.

articles.headline: Russian security service says United States warned about potential Moscow attack
articles.title: Russia’s FSB says U.S. warned Russia of possible Moscow attack
articles.summary: Russia’s Federal Security Service stated that American partner channels provided details regarding preparations for a terrorist strike in the capital. The U.S. Embassy in Moscow separately noted a credible threat at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve, leading authorities to temporarily close the palace park. Officials recalled a similar 2024 warning preceding the Crocus City Hall mass shooting.
articles.description: The ‌U.S. Embassy had warned that extremists ​had imminent plans for an attack in Moscow

articles.headline: Delhi police personnel protest transfers following Shahdara station scuffle
articles.title: Delhi Police personnel protest against transfers of ACP, SHO after Shahdara police station scuffle
articles.summary: Around 100 officers gathered outside the Delhi Police headquarters on November 2, 2026, demanding the reinstatement of Assistant Commissioner of Police Manasvi Vashistha and Station House Officer Arun Kumar. The transfers followed an October 23 scuffle at Shahdara police station that injured an advocate and sparked a district court lawyers strike. Senior officials persuaded the demonstrators to discuss grievances inside.
articles.description: Protesters demand reinstatement of Manasvi Vashistha and Inspector Arun Kumar, transferred after an advocate suffered a head injury and lawyers launched an indefinite strike

articles.headline: Drug menace continues to influence political discourse ahead of Punjab elections
articles.title: How can drug menace issue cast shadow on Punjab 2027 Assembly polls | Explained
articles.summary: The drug crisis remains a prominent political and social issue in Punjab ahead of the upcoming legislative elections. Successive governments from the Congress and Aam Aadmi Party have repeatedly failed to fulfill past campaign promises to eradicate the narcotics problem within short timeframes after assuming power in the state.
articles.description: As the election to the 117-member Punjab Assembly closes in, the drug menace appears to be becoming one big issue that can mobilise emotion and votes simultaneously, since addiction has touched a significant number of households in Punjab

articles.headline: Central Crime Branch links fake Siddaramaiah sting video to Kumaraswamy residence
articles.title: CCB probe into ‘sting video’ points to HDK’s Delhi residence, says Police Commissioner
articles.summary: Central Crime Branch investigators probing a fabricated sting video targeting former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah traced a device to Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy official residence in New Delhi. Police arrested freelance social media influencer Ritesh Pandey while two associates remain absconding. Authorities issued notices to the suspects as financial and digital investigations continue.
articles.description: The CCB also found that the mobile phone used for uploading the video was purchased in Karol Bagh, Delhi, specifically for the alleged operation

articles.headline: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky arrive in Belarus on route to Ukraine
articles.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city
articles.summary: Civilians evacuated from the devastated city of Oleshky landed in Gomel, Belarus, following a local ceasefire brokered by United States First Lady Melania Trump. The residents endured severe conditions without food, water, or electricity, with some surviving on garden weeds. The humanitarian truce allowed mine-clearing operations along escape routes before buses transported citizens toward Ukrainian territory.
articles.description: Oleshky residents had been without food, water and electricity, with many resorting to cooking garden weeds to survive.

articles.headline: Karnataka home minister alleges central agencies face pressure in recruitment case
articles.title: Priyank Kharge alleges attempt to use ED, I-T agencies against Congress leaders in KPSC case in Karnataka
articles.summary: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge alleged that an unnamed Union Minister is pressuring the Centre to deploy the Enforcement Directorate and Income Tax Department against him and his cabinet colleagues regarding KPSC recruitment irregularities. Bengaluru Police linked a fabricated sting video to Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy's official residence, according to Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh.
articles.description: The allegation comes after Karnataka’s Central Crime Branch, probing the alleged sting operation video targeting former chief minister Siddaramaiah, found a link to Union Minister H.D. Kumaraswamy’s official residence in New Delhi

articles.headline: Israeli attacks kill four Palestinians in Gaza despite ongoing ceasefire
articles.title: At least four Palestinians killed in Gaza as Israeli attacks continue
articles.summary: Ongoing military operations across the enclave resulted in multiple fatalities, including a teacher in Nuseirat and two girls in Khan Younis. Gaza health officials reported that recent casualties raised the death toll under the current ceasefire to 1,580. Meanwhile, United Nations human rights monitors warned that forced displacements and infrastructure destruction continued to spark ethnic cleansing concerns.
articles.description: Israel carried out several attacks in Gaza, including shelling the Nuseirat refugee camp.

articles.headline: Azam Khan moves Supreme Court challenging detention outside Rampur Jail
articles.title: Azam Khan moves Supreme Court against ED detention outside Rampur Jail
articles.summary: Senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan urged the Supreme Court to list a plea against his detention by the Directorate of Enforcement outside Rampur Jail on October 31, 2026. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant directed the seventy-eight-year-old politician to approach the Allahabad High Court, while advocate Nizam Pasha argued the arrest was politically motivated.
articles.description: The detention of senior Samajwadi party leader Azam Khan has happened with the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections in mind, Advocate Pasha said

articles.headline: Poland experiences judicial crisis amid suspension of constitutional tribunal judges
articles.title: Why is Poland witnessing a judicial crisis? Explained
articles.summary: Poland is facing a judicial crisis characterized by a political stand-off between the head of government and head of state. The situation escalated following the suspension of the chief judge and deputy of the Constitutional Tribunal by court members, resulting in clashes between political supporters and the deployment of riot police to secure the building.
articles.description: Mr. Tusk, who came back to power in 2023 promising to undo the PiS reforms, had found it virtually impossible to push any legislation given the veto power held by President Nawrocki and his predecessor Andrzej Duda, both PiS allies. Mr. Nawrocki has also declined to swear in four of six judges appointed to the court by a majority in the Sejm, the Polish lower house, alleging flaws in their selection procedure

articles.headline: Former Supreme Court judge Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul releases memoir
articles.title: Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul on his memoir ‘Without Fear or Favour’ and the executive’s growing influence over the collegium system
articles.summary: Former Supreme Court judge Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul reflects on a career spanning over two decades in his memoir Without Fear or Favour published by Juggernaut. The veteran jurist offers insight into judicial appointments, the executive influence over the collegium system, and the challenges of preserving judicial independence within India.
articles.description: The former Supreme Court judge on delays in clearing collegium recommendations and the need for reform

articles.headline: Weather department warns Andhra Pradesh may face another severe cyclonic storm
articles.title: After ‘Arnab’, Andhra Pradesh may face another severe cyclonic storm
articles.summary: Meteorologists predicted that a developing weather system over the Andaman Sea will intensify into a severe storm by November 2. The India Meteorological Department stated the system could make landfall in Andhra Pradesh with winds reaching 120 kmph. Disaster management authorities advised fishermen to stay ashore as heavy rainfall threatened districts statewide.
articles.description: The depression over Bay of Bengal is likely to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm by November 2; landfall is expected between Narsapur and Nellore on November 3, with maximum wind speed of 120 kmph

articles.headline: Sensex surges 765 points during early trade driven by Reliance earnings
articles.title: Markets open higher following AI-selling in Wall Street, fall in crude
articles.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty rose sharply in early trade on November 2, 2026, propelled by a strong rally in Reliance Industries shares following record quarterly profits. The 30-share BSE Sensex climbed 764.72 points to reach 75,216.80, while Brent crude oil prices declined 3 percent to 110 dollars per barrel.
articles.description: The rupee is expected to remain under pressure as crude oil is still hovering near $110 per barrel levels. The rupee fell 21 paise and was trading at 94.97 against the dollar in early trade

articles.headline: Ashutosh Dixit assumes charge as Indian Chief of Air Staff
articles.title: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as 29th Chief of Air Staff
articles.summary: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed command as the new Chief of Air Staff, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh following his retirement. Dixit brings four decades of service and over 3,500 flying hours across 20 aircraft types to the role, having previously served as Vice Chief of the force and Chief of Integrated Defence Staff.
articles.description: The IAF accorded a ceremonial guard of honour to the outgoing Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh at the Race Course Air Force Station before he handed over the baton to Ashutosh Dixit

articles.headline: Namibia secures maiden bilateral ODI series victory against Ireland
articles.title: Namibia scripts history with maiden bilateral ODI series win; stuns Ireland 3-2
articles.summary: Namibia defeated Ireland by five wickets in Windhoek to claim their first-ever bilateral one-day international series win against a Full Member nation. The victory on November 1, 2026, secured a 3-2 series triumph on home soil, bolstered by strong bowling performances from J.J. Smith and Jack Brassell which restricted Ireland to 129 runs.
articles.description: The victory provides Namibia a significant boost to their preparations for next year ICC men’s cricket World Cup

articles.headline: Telangana police widen investigation into illegal egg donation racket targeting vulnerable women
articles.title: Oocyte racket in Telangana: Women paid ₹20,000 as operators made around ₹3 lakh per cycle
articles.summary: Malkajgiri police are expanding an inquiry into an illegal oocyte trade that exploited economically disadvantaged women from multiple states by paying them minimal amounts while operators earned large sums per cycle. Authorities rescued 43 individuals during simultaneous raids in Hyderabad on November 1, 2026, and are now scrutinising medical records, forged consent documents, financial transactions, and the potential complicity of various fertility establishments.
articles.description: Police probe alleged exploitation of 43 women, including possible forged consent documents and illegal commissions, while examining recruitment networks, payment trails and the role of IVF and fertility centres in Hyderabad

articles.headline: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launches Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express
articles.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express flagged off by Railway Minister
articles.summary: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express on November 1, establishing a new overnight service connecting India tech capital with its financial hub. Operating six days a week, the train connects Sir M. Visvesvaraya Terminal in Bengaluru to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus in Mumbai while passing through Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Maharashtra. Vaishnaw also announced upcoming services towards Hubballi and Mangaluru to further improve regional rail connectivity.
articles.description: The overnight service will connect Bengaluru with Mumbai via Anantapur, Raichur, Kalaburagi, Solapur and Pune, improving connectivity across three States

articles.headline: Quad foreign ministers meet in Atlanta to review regional progress
articles.title: Quad delivering results for people in Indo-Pacific: Rubio
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio met External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, Japan's Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi, and Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong in Atlanta on October 31, 2026. According to Mr. Rubio, the officials reviewed Indo-Pacific cooperation and supply chains ahead of an upcoming summit in the Philippines. Mr. Jaishankar noted that the talks also focused on strengthening bilateral relations.
articles.description: The group reviewed progress in turning shared priorities into real benefits for the Indo-Pacific region

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh chief minister orders high alert over cyclone threat
articles.title: Naidu calls for high alert as another cyclone threat looms over Andhra Pradesh
articles.summary: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to accelerate restoration works following Cyclone Arnab and prepare for a potential new cyclone on October 31, 2026. A depression in the Bay of Bengal threatens south coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema with heavy rainfall from November 2 to November 4. Authorities were instructed to monitor satellite data and provide compensation for agricultural losses.
articles.description: Depression over southeast Bay of Bengal likely to intensify into a cyclone by November 1; officials told to monitor its movement every six hours and expedite restoration works in cyclone-hit areas

articles.headline: Union government releases tax devolution instalment of 1.09 lakh crore rupees
articles.title: Centre releases additional instalment of tax devolution of ₹1.09 lakh crore to states
articles.summary: The Union government released an additional tax devolution instalment exceeding 1.09 lakh crore rupees to state governments on October 31, 2026. The Finance Ministry stated that the funds aim to support state development expenditure and accelerate capital spending ahead of the festive season. States regularly receive forty-one percent of centrally collected taxes across fourteen annual instalments.
articles.description: This is in addition to the regular monthly devolution and the second additional instalment this financial year

articles.headline: Quad ministers express grave concern over economic coercion and overproduction
articles.title: Quad ministers express ‘grave concerns’ over economic coercion
articles.summary: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan, and Australia issued joint concerns regarding economic coercion and non-market policies during a meeting in Atlanta on October 31, 2026. Without naming countries, the alliance warned that arbitrary export restrictions and overcapacity disrupt global supply chains. The officials also emphasized the importance of preserving navigational rights and maritime security in critical global sea lanes.
articles.description: "The four ministers expressed grave concerns regarding economic coercion, including through arbitrary export restrictions," said a statement from the Quad alliance in Atlanta, Georgia.

articles.headline: South Carolina conservatives launch write-in campaign against Trump Senate pick
articles.title: Write-In Ralph: South Carolina Republicans challenge Trump’s Senate pick
articles.summary: Disillusioned young conservatives in South Carolina have initiated a grassroots write-in campaign for Republican Congressman Ralph Norman. According to Al Jazeera, voters feel betrayed by the US president and the Republican establishment following the appointment of Darline Graham to the Senate. The political tension highlights growing divisions within the state ahead of the November 3 election.
articles.description: As Trump supports Senator Darline Graham, one conservative group is rallying around someone else.

articles.headline: Church attacked during inauguration ceremony in West Bengal
articles.title: Church attacked in West Bengal during inauguration ceremony
articles.summary: An interfaith forum reported that a newly inaugurated church in the Basanti area was allegedly attacked by miscreants on November 1, 2026. The Bangiya Christiya Pariseba filed a police complaint after attendees and priests were reportedly injured during prayers. Local police from the Basanti Police Station stated that the incident initially appears to stem from an internal feud between two Christian groups.
articles.description: Local police from the Basanti Police Station have said that prima facie it looked like an internal feud between two Christian groups in the area

articles.headline: Four individuals booked following air pistol component parcel explosion
articles.title: Parcel explosion in Latur: Two gun shop owners among four booked
articles.summary: Four people, including two gun shop owners, have been booked by police after a parcel containing air pistol components exploded at a courier shop in Latur. The incident occurred on October 31, 2026, during the unloading of a tempo on Vilasrao Deshmukh Marg, leaving one person seriously injured. Authorities stated that the consignment was handled and transported negligently without required safety precautions.
articles.description: One person was seriously injured in the incident, which occurred on the morning of October 31, when parcels were being unloaded from a tempo on Vilasrao Deshmukh Marg

articles.headline: Civil Aviation Ministry launches international Digi Yatra trials at seven airports
articles.title: Digi Yatra trials start at 7 airports for international passengers
articles.summary: The Civil Aviation Ministry announced that Digi Yatra trials for international passengers have commenced across seven airports, with a broader rollout anticipated in 2027. The contactless facial recognition system is currently available on a trial basis for Indian nationals holding e-passports on select Air India and IndiGo flights. Feedback gathered through December will help authorities plan the future expansion of the technology.
articles.description: It will be available on a trial basis for Indian nationals holding e-passports for select international flights of Air India and IndiGo

articles.headline: Kimi Antonelli becomes Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion
articles.title: Kimi Antonelli’s historic title-winning F1 season: Five key moments
articles.summary: Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli secured the Formula 1 world championship at the Mexico City Grand Prix, becoming the sport's youngest-ever title winner at age 20. The Italian driver clinched the historic championship on November 1, 2026, capping off a remarkable season that featured multiple victories, a five-race winning streak, and consistent performances under intense competitive pressure.
articles.description: Securing the title on November 1, 2026 at the Mexico City Grand Prix confirms the rapid rise of a 20-year-old driver who hadn't won a race when 2026 began

articles.headline: CCTV skips Real Madrid match after Kylian Mbappé Mao Zedong joke
articles.title: China state broadcaster pulls La Liga matches following Mbappé joke
articles.summary: China Central Television did not air a Real Madrid match on Sunday following remarks by striker Kylian Mbappé regarding former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. China Media Group suspended Spanish football La Liga broadcasts after the incident, though it has acknowledged apologies from Mbappé, Real Madrid, and La Liga. Beijing previously suspended National Basketball Association broadcasts in 2019 over political sensitivities.
articles.description: China Media Group, which acknowledged Mbappé's apology, has not said how long the blackout will last.

articles.headline: U.S. approves Patriot missiles sale to Ukraine as delivery timelines remain uncertain
articles.title: Trump admin approves potential Patriot missiles sale to Ukraine
articles.summary: The United States State Department green-lit the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine following weeks of complaints regarding dwindling interceptor supplies. While the approval goes to Congress for review, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that deliveries could take years. The weapons sale will be funded by donations from allies rather than United States funds.
articles.description: The approval, which goes to Congress for review, comes after weeks of complaints by Ukrainian authorities that its supplies of the interceptor missiles were dwindling

articles.headline: Bapatla district administration prepares for Cyclone Murasu
articles.title: Bapatla administration gears up to tackle Cyclone Murasu
articles.summary: Bapatla district officials are preparing for Cyclone Murasu, which is forecast to cross the coast between Nellore and Ongole between November 2 and 3, 2026. District Collector Dr. Vinod Kumar V. urged residents to remain vigilant as heavy rainfall ranging from 100 mm to 120 mm is expected, increasing drainage pressure from neighbouring regions and requiring extended precautions across the area.
articles.description: The Bapatla District Collector directed all departments to remain alert and coordinate their response to the impending weather conditions

articles.headline: Beyond Cyclone Arnab: can India tackle the growing cost of natural disasters? | Insight India
articles.title: Beyond Cyclone Arnab: can India tackle the growing cost of natural disasters? | Insight India
articles.description: Cyclone Arnab hit the coast of Andhra Pradesh this week. In preparation, authorities evacuated people, halted transportation services and alerted disaster response forces. This is just the first cyclone of the northeast monsoon season. As climate change threatens to bring increasingly intense cyclones and other natural disasters, will India’s current disaster management programme be able to handle the social and economic costs I?n this episode, Sonikka Loganathan speaks to Safi Ahsan Rizvi, former Adviser to the National Disaster Management Authority, about what goes into disaster management, the costs to the economy and vulnerable populations, and how India has improved its strategy since 1999.

articles.headline: Wrestler Manisha Bhanwala secures historic World championship gold medal in Astana
articles.title: A dream come true moment for Manisha
articles.summary: Manisha Bhanwala became the first Indian woman wrestler to win a World championship gold by defeating the United States competitor Abigail Elizabeth Nette 8-6 in the final on October 31, 2026. Competing in the 59kg category in Astana, the 29-year-old athlete rebounded from a disappointing Asian Games performance. She dedicated the victory to her late father, helping propel the Indian women's team to a fifth-place finish.
articles.description: She becomes the first-ever Indian woman wrestler to land a World championship gold in Astana

articles.headline: Democratic Republic of Congo records over 5,000 deaths in deadliest Ebola outbreak
articles.title: More than 5,000 die from Ebola in DR Congo's deadliest outbreak
articles.summary: Government data shows that more than 5,000 people have died from an ongoing Ebola outbreak across eight provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Public health officials reported over 10,300 confirmed cases with a fatality rate of 48.6%. The World Health Organization stated that greater access to affected areas and key control measures are needed to end the epidemic.
articles.description: Government data shows that more than 10,000 people have contracted the rare virus.

articles.headline: Central teams inspect cyclone Arnab damage in Andhra Pradesh as relief sought
articles.title: Central teams assess cyclone Arnab damage in East Godavari, Konaseema as Naidu seeks ₹4,600 crore in relief
articles.summary: Two Inter-Ministerial Central teams inspected cyclone Arnab-hit regions across East Godavari, West Godavari, and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema districts on October 31, 2026, evaluating agricultural and infrastructural losses. Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu previously estimated total damages at ₹4,600 crore following the October 29 landfall. The assessment aims to verify extensive destruction to paddy fields, horticulture crops, and thousands of houses and fishing boats.
articles.description: Two Inter-Ministerial Central teams inspect damage to crops, houses, public infrastructure and fishing assets in the two districts; West Godavari reports extensive paddy, aquaculture and fishing boat losses

articles.headline: Four crew members eject safely after two Navy jets crash in Idaho
articles.title: Four crew members eject safely after two Navy jets crash during air show in Idaho
articles.summary: Four U.S. Navy crew members safely ejected after two EA-18G Growler jets collided during an air show on May 17, 2026, at the Mountain Home Air Force Base in western Idaho. The aircraft, from Washington state, plummeted to the ground and erupted in a fireball. Base officials reported that the four aviators were in stable condition and no ground injuries occurred.
articles.description: The collision involved two U.S. Navy EA18-G Growlers from the Electronic Attack Squadron 129 in Whidbey Island, Washington, said Cmdr Amelia Umayam, spokesperson for Naval Air Forces, U.S. Pacific Fleet

articles.headline: Arsenal defeats Liverpool to claim top position in Premier League
articles.title: Arsenal beats Liverpool to claim Premier League top spot
articles.summary: Premier League champions Arsenal defeated Liverpool 1-0 at Anfield on November 2, 2026, to move three points clear at the top of the league standings with 24 points from nine matches. German striker Kai Havertz scored the decisive goal in the 16th minute by converting a low cross from Declan Rice, handing Mikel Arteta's side their first away victory against Liverpool in 14 years.
articles.description: Kai Havertz scores only goal of the game as the champions claim first league victory at Anfield in 14 years

articles.headline: Iran foreign minister calls United States outreach positive while outlining conditions
articles.title: Iran FM says US outreach a ‘positive step’ as delegation in Qatar for talks
articles.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi described a diplomatic overture from United States Vice President JD Vance as a positive step during a statement on October 31, 2026. While an Iranian delegation visited Doha for consultations mediated by Qatar, Araghchi stated that direct meetings with American officials are unnecessary at this stage. Tehran demands the lifting of specific sanctions, reduced regional forces, and the release of frozen funds before implementing proposals.
articles.description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi tells Al Jazeera Tehran doesn't rule out attack, is ‘prepared for all scenarios’.

articles.headline: South Africa defeats Australia by 176 runs to claim Test series victory
articles.title: Harmer shines as South Africa wins third Test against Australia to claim series 2-1
articles.summary: Simon Harmer claimed career-best figures of 6-16 as South Africa dismissed Australia for 111 runs on October 31, 2026, securing a 176-run victory in the third Test in Cape Town. The win clinched the series 2-1 for the Proteas, who rose to the top of the International Cricket Council rankings. Harmer finished the match with ten wickets, while bowler Kagiso Rabada achieved his 350th Test wicket during the final day.
articles.description: The Proteas rallied from 1-0 down in the first Test series between the teams in South Africa since the ‘Sandpapergate’ scandal in 2018.

articles.headline: Formula 1 season preview highlights early competition and team performance dynamics
articles.title: How Red Bull tapped Max Verstappen’s sensitive side
articles.summary: Formula One fans witnessed Mercedes establish an early competitive advantage at the start of the 2026 season, according to reports published on October 31, 2026. While Ferrari emerged as the closest early challenger, the racing championship lacked a definitive indication that Italian outfit Scuderia Ferrari could sustain a championship challenge against the dominant front-runners throughout the lengthy motorsport calendar.
articles.description: The four-time champion’s extraordinary feel for the car has proven invaluable in the energy drink giant’s maiden attempt at building its own power unit. Red Bull’s turnaround — although too late to affect the title race — shows why Verstappen evokes such reverence within F1 .

articles.headline: Iran supreme leader warns United States and Israel against new attacks
articles.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader warns U.S., Israel against new attacks
articles.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei warned the United States and Israel during a meeting with senior military commanders on October 31, 2026. The supreme leader instructed forces to ensure any threat receives an immediate and geographically unrestricted response. The remarks coincided with diplomatic talks in Tehran involving Qatari officials addressing a letter from United States Vice President JD Vance.
articles.description: According to the statement, Mr. Khamenei ordered the commanders to ensure that "any level or type of threat must be met with an immediate, impactful and geographically unrestricted response".

articles.headline: Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Senate race
articles.title: Democrat endorses Republican candidate in key Michigan Senate race as party spat erupts
articles.summary: Haley Stevens endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers in the Michigan US Senate contest on Sunday. The endorsement followed an escalating dispute with Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed after a public clash over a campaign advertisement. Stevens made a surprise appearance alongside Rogers at a church, stating she no longer belonged in El-Sayed campaign. The Senate race is considered one of the tightest contests in the midterm elections determining control of Congress.
articles.description: The move by Haley Stevens, who lost out on the Democratic Senate nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, was called a "despicable betrayal" by one top Democrat.

articles.headline: Telangana farmers fear crop damage from cyclonic storm Murasu
articles.title: Cyclone Murasu | Paddy farmers in Telangana fear crop damage amid high market prices
articles.summary: Paddy and cotton farmers in six districts of Telangana face potential crop damage as cyclonic storm Murasu brings heavy rain forecasts from November 2 to 4, 2026. Growers worry about increased harvesting costs and weight loss in soaked grains. Meanwhile, Agriculture Department officials have issued alerts and are providing tarpaulin sheets to protect the produce.
articles.description: With soaked panicles delaying harvest, higher machine costs, and the need for extra drying and labor, growers warn that pre-flowering crops could suffer more, even as authorities issue alerts and supply protective tarpaulins to cushion the impact

articles.headline: Ukraine blames Russia for cyberattack on air alert app
articles.title: Russia, Ukraine air raid alert apps hit by cyberattacks after truce ends
articles.summary: Ukraine accused Russia of hacking its national air raid alert app on Sunday, causing false warnings of nuclear and chemical threats in Kyiv. SPRAVDI and the Ukrainian Air Force confirmed the breach, which followed the end of a ceasefire in Kherson. Hours later, Russia reported a similar cyberattack on its own emergency mobile application.
articles.description: Ukrainian users receive fake warnings of nuclear threats, while Moscow reports 'false information' on its app.

articles.headline: Israel's parliamentary elections end in deadlock as neither major bloc secures majority
articles.title: Israel voted for Israel: Why Gaza wasn’t on the ballot
articles.summary: Israel remains politically deadlocked after the October 27 polls failed to deliver a 61-seat majority for any coalition, with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's camp securing 53 seats. Despite massive voter turnout, the ongoing conflict in Gaza and related humanitarian crises were largely absent from campaign debates, which focused instead on domestic issues like judicial reforms and military exemptions. Analysts noted that military occupation and security fundamentally shaped voter perspectives across the political spectrum.
articles.description: Despite genocide, regional war and isolation, Israel's election revealed little appetite for political alternatives.

articles.headline: Early human migration in Arabian Peninsula required stone tools
articles.title: Science Snapshots: November 1, 2026
articles.summary: Researchers surveying the Rub al Khali desert discovered fifty five extinct lakes lacking stone tools, proving early humans required both water and toolmaking stones to migrate across Green Arabia. Scientists previously believed human expansion was driven solely by water availability. The findings provide new insights into prehistoric survival strategies.
articles.description: Three recent important research developments, all readable in one minute

articles.headline: Cyclonic storm Murasu approaches coast bringing heavy rainfall to southern states
articles.title: Storm ‘Murasu’ to bring very heavy rain over north Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: Cyclonic Storm Murasu moved west-northwestwards over the Bay of Bengal on November 1, 2026, and is projected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm before crossing the south Andhra Pradesh coast between November 2 and November 3. The Regional Meteorological Centre forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning across several districts in Tamil Nadu and neighboring regions over a multi day period.
articles.description: Isolated places over Chennai, Chengalpattu, Kancheepuram, Ranipet and Nilgiris districts are likely to get heavy rainfall on Monday, November 2; Chennai District Collector S. Malathi Helen announced holiday for schools on account of heavy rains

articles.headline: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy criticizes Prime Minister Modi during a Delhi protest.
articles.title: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy likens PM Modi to ‘Ravana’ and Congress to ‘Vanara Sena’
articles.summary: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy addressed party workers at Telangana Bhavan in Delhi on November 1, 2026, ahead of an opposition rally at Ramlila Maidan. He criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi and alleged that millions of votes belonging to poor citizens were being deleted as part of a political conspiracy. articles.description: Revanth Reddy likening PM Narendra Modi to Ravana, highlighted Congress cadre as ‘Vanara Sena’ as INDIA bloc stages protest against alleged SIR irregularities

articles.headline: Andy Burnham considers formal slavery apology while ruling out reparations
articles.title: Burnham opens door to formal apology for Britain’s slave trade
articles.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated he is open to issuing a formal state apology regarding Britain's role in the transatlantic slave trade, ahead of a Commonwealth leaders summit in Antigua and Barbuda. Speaking on Friday, Burnham rejected financial reparations but proposed an international initiative to reduce debt burdens for poorer nations, supported by former Prime Minister Gordon Brown. Caribbean leaders welcomed talks on broader cooperation.
articles.description: UK Prime Minister rules out financial reparations, despite longstanding Caribbean demands.

articles.headline: Yemen conflict displacement reaches 290,000 as fighting intensifies
articles.title: New Yemen fighting displaces 290,000, says UN, with pregnant women at risk
articles.summary: At least 290,000 people have been displaced in Yemen since August due to escalating conflict between government forces and Houthi rebels, according to the United Nations humanitarian office. The violence has heavily impacted Taiz governorate and caused severe shortages, while pregnant women and refugees face acute risks. Meanwhile, military operations and reported missile attacks continue across multiple fronts, including near Saudi Arabia and the presidential palace in Aden.
articles.description: A new outbreak in fighting in Yemen has forced tens of thousands of people from their homes.

articles.headline: Fatal business jet crash kills nine people in Florida
articles.title: Nine die in ‘cataclysmic’ Florida business jet crash
articles.summary: A Learjet 60 business travelling from Austin to the Bahamas crashed into a residential neighbourhood in South Florida, resulting in nine fatalities. United States Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed federal authorities are investigating the incident alongside the National Transportation Safety Board. Florida Governor Ron DeSantis described the crash as cataclysmic, noting that no ground casualties were reported.
articles.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis tells reporters there appeared to be no casualties on the ground.

articles.headline: Alphabet revenue growth highlights heavy artificial intelligence infrastructure spending costs
articles.title: Why investors are worried despite Alphabet’s 25% revenue growth and Google Cloud’s revenue more than doubling | Explained
articles.summary: The partial text notes that Alphabet reported strong growth in the September quarter while highlighting significant financial costs dedicated to keeping pace with the artificial intelligence sector. Heavy investments in computing infrastructure are required to develop artificial intelligence models. articles.description: Google’s parent company is investing heavily in artificial intelligence infrastructure as its cloud business expands. But the spending is weighing on cash flow, while AI-powered search raises questions about the future of its advertising business

articles.headline: Democrats hold high midterm expectations amid polling accuracy questions
articles.title: Democrats have high hopes for midterms - but are the polls right?
articles.summary: The Democratic Party anticipates strong performance in upcoming United States midterm elections driven by favourable surveys and public discontent over living costs. However, historical polling inaccuracies and shifting voter behavior introduce uncertainty regarding congressional control. Experts note that difficulties reaching conservative voters and financial advantages held by Republicans could impact final election outcomes.
articles.description: Polls have been predicting a Democratic surge, but last-minute deciders and sampling issues mean there's no guarantee.

articles.headline: Iranian lawmakers call for nuclear treaty withdrawal amid ongoing conflict
articles.title: Iran lawmakers call for withdrawal from NPT: Will we have war or peace?
articles.summary: Several Iranian legislators have urged the country to withdraw from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty and alter its nuclear doctrine following heavy costs from war and sanctions. The demands arrive as the conflict enters its ninth month and Qatari mediators pursue peace talks involving the United States. While Iranian leaders have not formally responded, the International Atomic Energy Agency previously raised concerns regarding Tehran's nuclear compliance.
articles.description: Withdrawal from the nuclear treaty doses not mean that Iran would build a nuclear weapon, observers say.

articles.headline: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
articles.title: US approves sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine
articles.summary: The United States State Department approved a 2.1 billion dollar sale of 500 Patriot interceptor missiles to Ukraine to defend against Russian aerial attacks. European allies and Canada funded the purchase entirely, with Lockheed Martin serving as the principal contractor. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned that the country was facing critical shortages as Russian ballistic missile strikes intensified across multiple regions.
articles.description: The American-made interceptors are the only effective weapon for downing Russia's ballistic missiles.

articles.headline: Iran warns of unfettered retaliation amid ongoing diplomatic efforts
articles.title: Iran warns of unfettered retaliation if attacked as mediators try for peace
articles.summary: Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered armed forces to prepare for an immediate, geographically unrestricted response if attacked again. Mediators from Qatar held talks in Tehran on Friday to prevent a new war as tensions persist over maritime security and regional conflicts. articles.description: Iran’s supreme leader says Tehran’s potential response will not be restricted by geography.

articles.title: Why governors’ races are important in the 2026 US midterms
articles.summary: Thirty-six US states will vote for governors in upcoming midterm elections, featuring significant turnover with open seats in nineteen contests. Governors direct public services, impact reproductive rights and election administration, manage federal policies, and frequently launch presidential campaigns. These key races will also influence the political landscape ahead of the presidential election in 2028.
articles.description: Historic turnover in this election will allow dozens of states to vote on significant changes in leadership.

articles.headline: UN warns of security risks in Western Sahara after peacekeeping mission ends
articles.title: UN warns of security risks in Western Sahara as peacekeeping mission ends
articles.summary: United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned of escalating security risks in Western Sahara following the conclusion of the MINURSO peacekeeping mission. The thirty-five-year operation ended after the UN Security Council failed to renew its mandate on Friday following a veto by Russia of a US-proposed resolution. Morocco welcomed the development, while Algeria expressed deep regret over the outcome.
articles.description: The mission, known as MINURSO, has been in place in the disputed region since a ceasefire in 1991.

articles.headline: Hundreds of evacuees from Oleshky arrive in Belarus
articles.title: Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky arrive in Ukraine via Belarus
articles.summary: Evacuees from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky have arrived in Gomel, Belarus, via four planes as part of an evacuation mission supported by United States First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo XIV. The civilians crossed the border during a regional truce that allows residents to choose between Ukrainian-held territory, Russian-held territory, or remaining in the city with replenished medical supplies.
articles.description: Four planes transporting evacuees from the war-ravaged city arrived in Belarus's Gomel earlier on Saturday.

articles.headline: Jio Platforms raises 3.2 billion dollars in stock market debut
articles.title: How Ambani’s Jio became India’s second-largest company

Backed by Meta and Google, the company serves over 530 million customers, though its rapid rise since 2016 has heavily concentrated India's telecommunications market and sparked intense industry competition.
articles.description: Jio makes India’s largest-ever stock market debut, raising $3.2bn in IPO.

articles.headline: Democrats target four Senate seats to overcome Republican majority
articles.title: Can Democrats win the US Senate? 10 key midterm races to watch
articles.summary: United States Democrats require a net gain of four seats in November midterm elections to wrest Senate control from Republicans who hold a 53-47 majority. Intensified by voter discontent over inflation, trade tariffs, and the war on Iran, tight races in states like Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, and Maine could determine the balance of power in Washington.
articles.description: From Texas to Maine, rising prices and the Iran war put key Senate races in play as Democrats fight for control.

articles.headline: United States Senator Chris Murphy hospitalized after suffering a stroke
articles.title: High-ranking US Democratic senator suffers stroke
articles.summary: United States Senator Chris Murphy, a high-ranking Democrat from Connecticut, is hospitalized and recovering after suffering a stroke over the weekend. His chief of staff, Allison Herwitt, stated on Sunday that he is awake, alert, and responding well to treatment at Johns Hopkins Hospital, though he remains sidelined ahead of congressional midterm elections.
articles.description: Senator Chris Murphy, a fierce Trump critic who is not up for re-election in the midterms, is 'alert' after a stroke.

articles.title: North Carolina voters weigh up Trump's track record on cost of living

articles.headline: Carlos Alcaraz defeats Alex de Minaur to win Vienna Open title
articles.title: Alcaraz beats De Minaur to win Vienna Open without dropping a set to clinch fourth title this year
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz defeated Alex de Minaur 6-1, 6-4 to win the Vienna Open on Sunday without dropping a single set. The victory marked the Spanish player's fourth title of the year and his twenty-eighth overall victory. Alcaraz secured his seventh consecutive win against the Australian opponent in the final of the ATP 500 event.
articles.description: Carlos Alcaraz has beaten Alex de Minaur on grass and clay as well as on indoor and outdoor hard courts

articles.headline: P.V. Sindhu and Lakshya Sen win Hylo Open titles in Saarbrucken
articles.title: Sindhu, Lakshya make it a double delight for India
articles.summary: Indian badminton players P.V. Sindhu and Lakshya Sen secured singles titles at the Hylo Open Super 500 tournament in Saarbrucken on Sunday. articles.description: The former world champion Sindhu adds the Hylo Open to the Japan Open triumph earlier in the year and boosts her hopes of making the World Tour Finals while the latter ends his title drought in style

articles.description: UN Security Council rejected the competing proposals, leaving the peacekeeping mission without an approved extension.

articles.headline: Haley Stevens endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan Senate race
articles.title: Why did Democrat Haley Stevens just endorse a Republican for US Senate?

articles.description: Stevens’s endorsement of Mike Rogers comes after a bitter dispute with Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed.

articles.headline: Evacuation corridor opens in Russian-occupied Oleshky under a temporary ceasefire
articles.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
articles.summary: The evacuation of the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky is under way following a ceasefire brokered by United States First Lady Melania Trump. Residents wishing to leave have a four-hour window using a convoy of twenty-five buses organised by Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and his Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova. According to Ivan Rusev of Tuzly Lagoons national park, military sonar systems, explosions, and pollution from damaged warships disorient dolphins, impairing their echolocation and causing self-poisoning and fatal infections. Environmental degradation also threatens birds and fish populations, with cetacean recovery estimated to require up to fifty years.
articles.description: Conflict devastates Black Sea marine life, killing more than 120,000 dolphins and causing ecological damage.

articles.headline: Israel elections chief says vote inquiry will not change outcome

articles.summary: Nearly 200 nations approved key texts at the COP17 biodiversity summit in Yerevan, Armenia, aiming to revive goals of halting nature destruction by 2030. articles.title: Trump backtracks on rallies in turbulent end to midterms campaign

articles.description: The U.S. President reinstated two rallies in Kansas and Iowa a day after cancelling them, saying Republicans “have a shot” in the midterms as a record 47.9 million Americans have already voted

articles.headline: New York governor signs legislation restricting artificial intelligence chatbot interactions with minors
articles.title: New York restricts AI chatbot interactions with children | Explained

Additionally, the new law requires manufacturers of internet-connected baby monitors to implement security safeguards against unauthorised access to audio and video streams.

articles.headline: Crypto exchange platform Binance suffers major cyberattack resulting in asset loss

articles.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange platform Binance experienced a cyberattack on October 29 that resulted in asset losses exceeding six billion dollars. articles.headline: US, South Korea, and Japan urge complete denuclearization of North Korea

articles.title: Oman rescues 25 from burning ship, Iran halts tankers
articles.summary: Oman's navy rescued 25 crew members from the Panamanian-flagged merchant ship RITI after it was attacked and caught fire on October 30, 2026, according to the Maritime Security Centre. A video showed an officer engulfed in flames from a homemade incendiary device. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez reported that 159 law enforcement officers were injured during demonstrations against living costs, though no suspects have been arrested yet.
articles.description: No arrests made after several security officers were reportedly injured during incidents at Saturday's protests.

articles.headline: Madras High Court rules on court fee refunds in civil settlements

articles.headline: India defeats Malaysia 4-2 at Asian Champions Trophy after Harmanpreet hat-trick
articles.title: Asian Champions Trophy: Harmanpreet’s hat-trick helps India down Malaysia

Malaysia tested the hosts before falling behind, while Japan and Korea also secured their places in the upcoming tournament semifinals.
articles.description: Japan and Korea join the two teams in the semifinals

articles.headline: Helicopter operators threaten service suspension over new two pilot mandate

articles.summary: Helicopter operators in Uttarakhand threatened to suspend Char Dham charter services starting November 2, 2026, protesting a new directive by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation and the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority requiring two pilots per sortie.
